title: Head of GTM Strategy and Planning
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model - which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Global Lead, GTM Strategy and Planning will work as part of the Revenue Operations leadership team, reporting to the SVP Revenue Operations. This role is the strategic architect of Celonis' annual and multi-year GTM planning processes, coordinating across Sales, Marketing, Value Engineering, Services, Finance, and the broader business to ensure aligned, balanced, and executable go-to-market strategy. This person is responsible for ensuring our GTM investments, resource allocation, and organizational structure are optimized to drive sustainable growth and performance.

The Role:

This role owns the design and execution of our integrated GTM planning processes. You will lead comprehensive territory planning, segmentation strategy, role definition, and resource allocation exercises that balance growth objectives with sustainable unit economics. You will be the custodian of our GTM ratios and thought leader on how we structure our go-to-market. You will design and maintain the planning systems and frameworks we use to make decisions, while also being comfortable working offline and with custom modeling to stress-test plans and guide strategic decisions. You will coordinate senior stakeholders across the business to build consensus around the plan and drive alignment on priorities, resource allocation, and GTM strategy. Beyond planning, you will run critical programs and projects throughout the year that ladder up to the plan-such as Global Accounts management, New Logo strategy, and organizational design initiatives.

The work you’ll do:

• Lead the annual GTM planning process; coordinate across all business functions to build an integrated, bottom-up and top-down plan that balances growth with profitability

• Develop and maintain territory and segment strategy; design territory structures that optimize for pipeline generation, ACV/ARR growth, and team productivity

• Define and refine GTM ratios (AE to SDR, territories to manager, etc.); analyze performance and recommend adjustments to optimize resource allocation

• Conduct role and organizational design analysis; think through optimal coverage models, account assignments, and team structures to drive business outcomes

• Build and maintain planning systems and frameworks; ensure consistency and rigor in how we approach planning, modeling, and decision-making

• Develop and test custom models and scenarios to stress-test plans; guide leadership through trade-offs and help them understand implications of different strategic choices

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholder alignment on the plan; facilitate discussions with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to build buy-in and ensure feasibility

• Communicate the plan cascading priorities, resource allocation, and expected outcomes to the broader organization

• Lead GTM strategy initiatives and programs throughout the year, such as: Global Accounts strategy and operations, New Logo go-to-market approach, market expansion planning, channel and partner strategy

• Develop and maintain critical business reporting and dashboards; track plan versus actual, highlight variances, and provide insights to guide course corrections

title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output-new logo, expansion, and renewals-and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals-and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new-this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

- Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes-accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

- Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

- Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

- Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion-driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

- Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

- Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy-owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

- Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

- Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales-you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

- Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

- Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change-not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

- Commercial instincts

title: Compliance Senior Analyst
description:
Who are we and what do we do?
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers-including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google-to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management-all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more -helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.

Role in a Nutshell
BrowserStack 's Compliance team owns the company's compliance posture across the security and privacy frameworks it operates under globally, making that posture verifiable to customers, auditors, and regulators. As a Compliance Analyst, you will work across certification audits, framework implementation,
customer security assurance, contract review, and compliance operations. Depending on your experience, you may support or independently own different parts of these processes. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, takes ownership of problems rather than just tasks, and enjoys turning ambiguous requirements into practical processes. This role offers the
opportunity to build deep expertise in compliance while gradually taking ownership of larger areas of the function.
The level of ownership will vary based on your experience, with opportunities to progressively take ownership of larger areas of the compliance program.
Responsibilities
● Support and, based on experience, independently manage BrowserStack 's compliance certifications and audit cycles, including audit planning, evidence collection, control testing, documentation, remediation, and auditor coordination.
● Implement and maintain controls for frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001, and applicable data privacy regulations, working closely with control owners across the organization.
● Track audit, framework, and remediation action items through closure and maintain an accurate and up-to-date view of BrowserStack 's control environment.
● Translate framework and regulatory requirements into practical, workable controls in collaboration with Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, and other teams.
● Respond to customer security questionnaires, RFIs, and security assurance requests, including handling more complex or technical questions as experience grows.
● Maintain and improve the internal knowledge base used to support customer security responses, ensuring information remains accurate as the product, controls, and certifications evolve.
● Contribute to BrowserStack 's public-facing security documentation and Trust Center, ensuring that published information accurately reflects the company's actual control environment.
● Review vendor and customer contracts for security, privacy, and compliance risks against established review standards and support the development of reusable review guidelines and clause libraries.

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. This role is designed as an embedded engineering safety position rather than a standalone site-wide H&S management role. The Senior Systems Safety Engineer will work directly with engineering and operations teams to identify hazards, evaluate system risks, and develop practical mitigation strategies during system design, installation, validation, commissioning, and operation.

title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
description:
About Odyssey:

K-12 education is one of the most consequential determinants of a child’s future - and many families have had limited ability to shape how and where their child learns. Education Savings Account (ESA) programs are changing that. One of the fastest-growing public education initiatives in the U.S., they give states the ability to put education funding directly in the hands of families, who can then choose the learning experiences that best fit their child - from schools and tutors to therapy, curriculum, and technology.

But once these policies are signed into law, states face an enormous operational challenge. They must stand up entirely new programs, manage the secure and compliant flow of public funds, approve and monitor thousands of vendors, support families at scale, and prevent fraud - all while delivering a high-quality user experience.

That’s where Odyssey comes in.

We partner with state agencies to design, launch, and operate ESA and school chocie programs on their behalf. We provide the technology, program operations, vendor ecosystem, and family experience that make these programs actually work in the real world. Today, we operate across 10 states, and our platform powers programs serving 250,000+ students and over $2B in annual education funding - and we’re just getting started.

Most recently, we launched the Texas Education Savings Account (EFA) program - the biggest day-one ESA launch in the country - which has already received nearly 200,000 applications. It’s the kind of moment that captures exactly what we’re building toward: programs that work at scale, from day one, when it matters most.

We’re backed by respected investors, including a16z and Tusk Venture Partners, and we’re building the team that will take us to the next stage.

Odyssey sits at the intersection of GovTech, EdTech, and FinTech. We are a public-sector operator, a technology company, and a program delivery partner all at once. The work we do is civic infrastructure - it determines whether families can access life-changing educational opportunities.

WHY THIS WORK IS DIFFERENT

We’re in the weeds with state partners, internally with our product teams, and turning ambiguous policy into real systems that families depend on. This means building a platform that meets each state’s configuration needs while being flexible enough to support all customers. We are not building be-spoke software!

If you want a highly structured environment, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want ownership, speed, and problems that actually matter, you’ll feel right at home.

The role is focused on high-quality financial execution, including maintaining accurate books in QuickBooks Online (QBO), mapping financial data prepared by local accounting partners, completing reconciliations and foreign currency translations, and preparing information for group-level reporting and consolidation.
You will report to the Financial Lead, who retains responsibility for strategic finance decisions, high-level compliance, and final audit sign-offs. This opportunity is best suited to an experienced accountant who enjoys hands-on work, multi-entity accounting, and independently managing recurring deliverables.
ENGAGEMENT, SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

•
Engagement type : Independent contractor.

•
Location : Fully remote. Applicants must be based in the Philippines, Indonesia, or Malaysia. Some on-site work might be done for applicants based in Shanghai.

•
Rate : USD 15.00 per hour, based on actual approved working hours recorded through monthly timesheets.

•
Schedule : Flexible, with workload concentrated around month-end close, statutory filing deadlines, and annual audit requirements.

•
Collaboration hours : The contractor must be able to maintain reliable overlap with the Financial Lead during Singapore/Shanghai business hours, generally within 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Shanghai/Singapore time when work is scheduled.

Work Hours:

•
Standard months (-9 months/year; January - March & July - December): Approximately 40 to 80 hours per month. Capped at 80 hours/month.

•
Audit period (-3 months/year; April to June) : Full-time dedicated capacity. 8 hours per workday capped at 160 hours/month.

• Any hours exceeding the monthly ceiling require prior written approval from the Financial Lead.

Availability and focus requirement: This engagement requires the contractor's full professional attention during agreed working hours. Contractors may have other clients or projects, provided those commitments do not overlap with scheduled NEX work. This role is not intended to be performed as a side job alongside another full-time position.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Financial Accounting and Bookkeeping

• Maintain full-charge bookkeeping for three Singapore entities in QuickBooks Online using established internal accounting processes.

Pre-Sales Engineering & Business Expansion

Internal Tools & Documentation Development

Industry Representation & Events

- Represent NETGEAR at U.S. industry conferences and partner events

- Deliver technical workshops and presentations

- Provide advanced AV-over-IP education and roadmap overviews

- Support event-based network deployments and multi-vendor interoperability demonstrations

QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum 5 years of experience in networking systems, AV-over-IP technologies, or related systems engineering roles

- Deep knowledge of ProAV networking products, AV-over-IP technologies, multicast networking and IGMP, and switch profile development

- Strong understanding of routing and switching fundamentals

- Hands-on deployment experience with AVB, Dante, Q-SYS, Crestron, SMPTE-2059-2, and multicast networks

title: Site Acquisition Manager
description:
About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure. The company builds and operates a global network of ultra-efficient, AI-ready data centers with waterless cooling for colocation, hyperscale and build-to-suit customers. The highly differentiated infrastructure platform is the first large-scale, global deployment of waterless cooling platform-wide and transforms data center growth into a catalyst for sustainable development. Edged is backed by a deep proprietary technology stack that will include renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators, and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment with more than a dozen new data centers operating or under construction across Europe and North America and a gigawatt-scale project pipeline. The North American division of Edged is a joint venture between one of the largest private multinational corporations in the world and an affiliate of Endeavour. Endeavour is a purpose-driven organization helping innovators to develop and launch breakthrough solutions for global challenges in the areas of energy, water, and waste. Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems.
Opportunity The Site Acquisition Manager will be a valued member of the Corporate Development team of the North American division of Edged Data Centers (“Edged”). The Manager will conduct site evaluation and acquisition activities that support the overall expansion strategy and growth objectives of Edged Data Centers. This position will work extensively across various internal and external stakeholders including the Sales, Design, and Construction teams as well as consultants, brokers, due diligence vendors, and power companies. The Site Acquisitions Manager will work with the broader Corporate Development team to help source and diligence new acquisitions and evaluate investment opportunities. The Site Acquisition Manager needs to be an agile, team-focused individual, with a proven ability to source and evaluate multiple sites for data center development viability across several North American markets simultaneously. The right person is highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team. Edged achieves successful outcomes by empowering our people, by developing a habit of constant, open communication, and by creating a culture of excellence, appreciation, trust, and respect. Key Responsibilities
Include but are not limited to:

• Identify and evaluate sites for acquisition to facilitate the company’s expansion strategy and meet key growth objectives

• Work with Corporate Development team to underwrite and diligence new opportunities, put together investment memos, market analysis and business plans to support underlying acquisition targets

• Coordinate the evaluation of power procurement, entitlements, development feasibility, and customer requirements to assist in the prioritization of sites and inform the acquisition and underwriting process

• Work across internal and external stakeholders to formulate the business case justification for acquisition of selected sites

• Manage the acquisition process from identification through closing by negotiating purchase agreements, supporting due diligence efforts, and assisting with the acquisition approval process

• Create site evaluation and acquisition reporting and updates for senior management and stakeholder reviews

• Interface with municipalities, economic development entities, and customer teams

• Manage third-party real estate, legal, and due diligence vendors and contracts

title: Junior Regulatory Consultant
description:
Role Summary

The Junior Regulatory Consultant provides hands-on regulatory support for established processes, document maintenance, standards management, and submission preparation activities. This role is best suited for work where the regulatory strategy or requirements have already been defined and the primary need is efficient execution, coordination, research, and documentation.

Key Responsibilities

• Support ongoing standards management activities, including monitoring, tracking, and maintaining applicable regulatory and consensus standards.

• Review standards and regulatory requirements for updates and identify changes requiring internal assessment.

• Maintain standards inventories, applicability assessments, and related compliance records.

• Perform routine regulatory documentation updates using established templates, procedures, and source records.

• Draft and update technical and regulatory documents based on information supplied by internal subject matter experts.

• Support preparation and organization of documentation for international regulatory submissions.

• Compile submission components, supporting evidence, and required records.

• Assist with maintenance and development of Technical Documentation.

• Support document gap assessments and remediation activities under senior regulatory direction.

• Assist with Quality Management System documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, and controlled records.

• Maintain regulatory trackers, databases, compliance matrices, and submission records.

• Support development and maintenance of compliance information management systems.

• Conduct regulatory and standards research and summarize findings for review.

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain necessary documentation and records.

• Provide ongoing ad-hoc regulatory and documentation support as business needs arise.

Typical Assignments

• Standards monitoring and standards database maintenance

• Updating documents to current templates

• Drafting documents from provided source records

• Maintaining regulatory trackers Criterion Edge | Regulatory Consulting

• Compiling submission documentation

• Technical Documentation maintenance

• QMS document updates

• Regulatory research

• Compliance database administration

• Supporting straightforward international submissions

Recommended Experience

• Approximately 2-5 years of regulatory affairs, quality, medical device, pharmaceutical, or related industry experience.

• Working knowledge of regulated documentation and document-control practices.

• Familiarity with FDA, EU MDR/IVDR, ISO standards, and/or international regulatory frameworks.

• Strong technical writing, research, organization, and documentation skills.

• Ability to execute defined regulatory activities with limited strategic oversight.

title: People Business Partner
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for an experienced, strategic People Business Partner to join our team to shape and scale our people strategy. This role will directly influence leadership, drive cultural impact, and enhance operational excellence across the company. As a trusted advisor, you will lead key initiatives and support managers and employees to build a strong, high-performing organization.

 

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Own and drive key People functions for your client groups, including manager enablement (talent management, coaching, training), business strategy alignment (workforce planning, change management, analytics), people program development (performance management, compensation, succession planning), and employee relations (PIPs, investigations, terminations, compliance).

- Use periodic evaluations and frequent touchpoints to identify individual, team, and manager development needs, make recommendations, and partner closely with managers to implement strategies that measurably improve performance, engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

- Provide guidance and leadership in the following areas: total rewards, leveling, employee engagement, culture development, organizational design, change management, employee communications, and people development.

- Own the entire employee lifecycle for performance management, development, and advancement.

- Execute on other People or general operations responsibilities as required by the People team on an ad hoc basis.

We are looking for someone who has:

- 8+ years of HRBP experience, within a high-growth tech environment.

- A high level of both IQ and EQ.

- Hands-on operational experience facilitating people programs and a thorough knowledge of HR procedures and policies.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to organize and interpret data.

Nice to have:

- Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, or a related field.

- Experience scaling teams in a high-growth tech company through an IPO.

- Experience partnering with founders to shape people strategies that drive performance, engagement, and organizational success.

- Experience working in an international company, with a preference for experience in Japan, Korea, or Germany.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Mainframe Storage Architect - Remote
description:
Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to a variety of F ortune 100/500/1000 and other companies in Canada/US.We are currently hiring for a Mainframe Storage Consultant for our global IT infratructure consulting client.

Location: Canada , EST - remote

Rate: $100-120/hr CAD C2C

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 12 months + multiple long term extensions
Job Description:
A mainframe storage architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the storage infrastructure of a mainframe system. A mainframe storage architect works closely with the mainframe system administrator, the mainframe application developers, and the business users to ensure that the storage solutions meet the performance, availability, security, and scalability requirements of the organization.
Responsibilities:

• Design and implement storage solutions for mainframe systems, including disk, tape, and virtual storage devices

• Monitor and optimize the performance, capacity, and utilization of the storage infrastructure

• Ensure the backup, recovery, and disaster recovery of the mainframe data

• Develop and enforce storage policies, standards, and procedures · Provide technical support and troubleshooting for storage-related issues

• Research and evaluate new storage technologies and products

• Document and maintain the storage architecture and configuration Qualifications

• At least 5 years of experience in mainframe storage administration and architecture

• Expert knowledge of mainframe storage hardware and software, such as IBM DS8000, TS7700, DFSMS, SMS, HSM, RMM, and FDR, VTS, DASD

• Strong skills in mainframe storage performance tuning, troubleshooting, and problem-solving

• Proficient in mainframe storage scripting and automation tools, such as REXX, CLIST, JCL, and TSO

• Familiarity with mainframe operating systems, such as z/OS, z/VM, and z/VSE

• Good communication and collaboration skills

• Certification in mainframe storage or related fields is a plus

title: Staff Engineer - AI Platform
description:

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.
About the Role:

We're looking for a Staff Engineer (AI) to architect and build the agentic systems and AI foundations within our Platform Services team - the team responsible for the shared infrastructure, internal tooling, and core services that other product teams build on.

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role: you will set technical direction, write and review code, and own the design of systems that let HighLevel engineering teams build, ship, and operate AI-driven capabilities reliably at enterprise scale.

What You'll Build:

• Production-grade agentic systems - multi-step, tool-using agents with orchestration, planning, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls - for platform automation and internal engineering workflows.

• A shared AI platform for product teams: reusable agent frameworks, tool and MCP integrations, an LLM gateway (routing, rate limiting, caching, fallbacks), and prompt/model versioning.
Evaluation and observability for AI systems - eval harnesses, tracing of agent runs, and metrics for quality, latency, cost, and safety.

• AI-driven engineering practices that improve developer velocity - agentic developer workflows, AI-assisted tooling, and automation of operational toil.

• Cloud infrastructure for AI workloads across GCP/AWS, including provisioning, scaling, security, and cost governance for inference and token spend.

What You'll Drive:

•
Architecture & Scale: Own and evolve the architecture of agentic systems and AI platform services, ensuring they are reliable, extensible, and performant under enterprise-scale load.

•
AI-First Culture: Set and drive an AI-first culture within the Platform Services team - making AI tools and agentic workflows the default way the team builds and operates.

•
Reliability & Safety: Build agents that fail safely - with guardrails, scoped permissions, sandboxing, defenses against prompt injection, audit trails, graceful degradation, and clear incident management practices.

•
Evaluation & Data-Driven Decisions: Establish rigorous evaluation practices - offline evals, regression suites, and production monitoring - so agent behavior is measurable and comparable across model and prompt changes. Use that data to prioritize, evaluate trade-offs, and report on agent quality, platform health, and cost.
